g.title: BATT
g.text: battery sense board solder pads (flying leads)
staked within 10 mm of the pads; F0A, F0B, F3 in BAT_TOP (BQ771806 on the sense board, own taps), F0N in BAT_BOT, 3 x 68.1 ohm + FT0-FT4 in the taps
pack side; NTC2 returns to TAP0 inside the pack

g.title: W1-22
g.text: M22759/33-22; two wires per pole, twisted quad (1+3, 2+4); 2.0 A worst-case pack current (four burn drivers), 1.2 A per wire with a 60/40 split, 2.5 A derated (EEE-INST-002, N = 43); 35 mV at 2.0 A

g.title: W1-24
g.text: M22759/33-24 (Micro-Fit minimum); NTC1 pair (own return) twisted; heater pair twisted, 79 mA (SW5 limit 0.17 A)

g.title: W1-28
g.text: M22759/33-28; sense only (balancing 9 mA); a tap short is limited to 82 mA at the pack

g.title: J1
g.text: EPS J1, right-angle gold header on the EPS bottom side, zone Z1 (PACK domain corner)

g.title: J2
g.text: EPS J2 to AFE U1 and secondary protector U2
